audits.name: credential_scan
audits.command:
python3 -c import pathlib,re,sys
roots=[pathlib.Path("system"),pathlib.Path("evidence-packs"),pathlib.Path("scripts"),pathlib.Path(".github")]
patterns=[
    re.compile(rb"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}:[0-9a-fA-F]{32}"),
    re.compile(rb"AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}"),
    re.compile(rb"(?:sk|rk)-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}"),
]
hits=[]
for root in roots:
    for path in root.rglob("*"):
        if path.is_file():
            data=path.read_bytes()
            if any(pattern.search(data) for pattern in patterns):
                hits.append(str(path))
print("credential-shaped matches:",len(hits))
print("credential scan clean" if not hits else "\n".join(hits))
sys.exit(bool(hits))
